log: MEASURED DNA TORSION vs THE 0.663 BAR
GSE277502 bTMP-seq, hTERT-RPE1, hg38, 20 kb bins. The CRISPR assay is K562, so this is a
CROSS-CELL-LINE transfer and a null has two possible causes this test cannot separate.
THE BAR IS RECOMPUTED, NOT ASSUMED. The CTCF peak file the recorded 0.6632 was produced
from lived in the ephemeral scratch directory and is gone, so the arm is rebuilt from
ENCODE ENCFF362OPG (K562 CTCF IDR thresholded, ENCSR000AKO, GRCh38, 44,104 peaks). That is
a DIFFERENT peak set, so the bar measured here is the one torsion is judged against, and
its distance from the recorded 0.6632 is reported as a check on the reconstruction.
